disable_jax_optimizations: call disable_jax_optimizations to turn off JAX optimizations and save the current config
restore_jax_config: call restore_jax_config to restore the previously saved JAX configuration values
check_jax_compilation_disabled: call jax_compilation_is_disabled to check if JAX backend compilation is currently disabled
prevent_jax_compilation: use no_jax_compilation_allowed as a context manager to prevent JAX compilation in a scope
review_jax_utils: review the jax_utils module to understand JAX optimization and compilation control utilities
